info.title: VitalPulse API
info.description:
HL7 **FHIR R4** (4.0.1) server for vital signs: `Patient` and `Observation` resources in JSON.

**Authentication:** sign up with `POST /auth/register` or log in with `POST /auth/login`, then click **Authorize** and paste the token. Every `/fhir` interaction needs it, except `GET /fhir/metadata`.

**Roles:** `admin` manages patients (create, update, delete); `clinician` (every new account) reads patients and records, reads and corrects observations. The first admin is created with `npm run seed:admin`.

**Format:** requests and responses use `application/fhir+json` (`application/json` is accepted too). Every error, FHIR or not, is an `OperationOutcome`; its `issue[].code` says what went wrong and `issue[].expression` points at the element at fault.

**Server-side clinical logic:** for each observation the server sets the unit from the LOINC code, adds the `referenceRange` and works out the `interpretation` (`N`, `L`, `H`, `LL`, `HH`). Clients cannot send them.

**Search:** results come as a `searchset` `Bundle` with `total` and `link` (`self`, `first`, `previous`, `next`, `last`). Follow `next` to page. Repeating a parameter means AND; a comma inside one value means OR. Unknown parameters are ignored unless you send `Prefer: handling=strict`.

**Rate limit:** 100 requests every 15 minutes per IP; then `429`.

put.description: Full replacement: elements left out are removed. The body must carry the same `id` as the URL. Send `If-Match` with the ETag you read to avoid overwriting someone else's change. Ids are never chosen by the client, so an unknown id answers 405.

412.description: If-Match does not match the current version.

issue.diagnostics: Version conflict: If-Match asks for version 1, but the current version is 2.

delete.description: Afterwards a read answers 410 Gone. Deleting again answers 204. A patient with observations cannot be deleted: set `active: false` instead.

issue.diagnostics: Patient/6ad8cb2dae6aed0f2dc7762b has observations and cannot be deleted. Update it with active: false instead.

get.description: Filters, sorting and paging combine in one query, e.g. `patient=Patient/{id}&code=8867-4&interpretation=H,HH&date=ge2026-10-01&_sort=-date&_count=20`.

parameters.description: `Observation:patient` adds the patients of the page to the Bundle.

post.description:
Supported LOINC codes: `8867-4` heart rate (/min), `9279-1` respiratory rate (/min), `8310-5` body temperature (Cel), `2708-6` oxygen saturation (%).

The server sets the unit, `referenceRange` and `interpretation`. Business rules answer **422**: unsupported code, wrong unit, impossible value, unknown, deleted or inactive patient, or a correction status on create.

201.description: Created, with the interpretation worked out by the server.

issue.diagnostics: Observation.interpretation: interpretation is calculated by the server from the value; do not send it
Body temperature is measured in "Cel", not "[degF]".

put.description: A new version, e.g. `status: amended` with a new value, or `entered-in-error`. The interpretation is worked out again. Patient and code cannot change. Observations cannot be deleted (`DELETE` answers 405): the record keeps every correction.

405.description: Unknown id (no client-defined ids), or DELETE.

issue.diagnostics: DELETE is not supported on /fhir/Observation/6ad8cb2dae6aed0f2dc77631. Allowed: GET, PUT.

ifMatch.name: If-Match
ifMatch.description: ETag of the version you are changing, e.g. `W/"1"`. If it is not the current one: 412.

count.name: _count
count.description: Page size: default 10, maximum 50 (larger values are reduced). `0` returns only the total.

page.name: _page
page.description: Page number, from 1. Easier: follow the Bundle `next` link.

prefer.name: Prefer
prefer.description: `handling=strict` turns unknown parameters into a 400 instead of ignoring them.

ETag.description: Version as a weak ETag, e.g. W/"1". Send it back in If-Match.

unit.description: Optional on input; the server sets it from the LOINC code.

code.description: UCUM code. Must match the vital sign if sent.

id.description: Set by the server. Required on update, equal to the URL id.

items.description: Needs a family name or at least one given name.

birthDate.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future.

status.description: On create: registered, preliminary or final.

category.description: Optional; if sent it must be vital-signs.

effectiveDateTime.description: With time and time zone; not in the future.

interpretation.description: Worked out by the server. Sending it is a 400.

referenceRange.description: Set by the server. Sending it is a 400.
